name: Don't Bother Me! Baby Tee
note:
A fitted white baby tee with a burgundy cat graphic and ‘DON’T BOTHER ME!’ statement across the front. The blank back keeps the focus on the vintage-inspired print.

180 GSM, 100% super-combed cotton. Pre-shrunk and bio-washed, with a ribbed crew neckline and double-stitched construction. Fitted baby-tee silhouette.
